text: Targets x86 bare metal (no host OS dependency at runtime)
Includes a bootloader (own boot code that the machine/QEMU starts)
Includes a kernel loaded/started by the bootloader
Kernel produces VGA text-mode output (writes to 0xB8000)
No external libraries (freestanding, no libc/runtime libs)
Runnable in QEMU (buildable image boots in qemu-system-i386/x86_64)
Lives in the current directory with a reproducible build (e.g. Makefile/script)
